parts.text: Eta threshold is 1.4861 GeV. User asks W=1.45 GeV, which is BELOW threshold (1.45 < 1.4861). Also they say "above the Delta" — the Delta is around 1.23 GeV, but eta production threshold is higher (~1.486 GeV). So W=1.45 is physically impossible for eta electroproduction (below threshold). I should refuse and explain. Let me verify with preflight to be thorough.

Clearly impossible. W=1.45 < threshold 1.4861 GeV. Need to refuse, write outcome.json with action "refuse". No input files produced. Need to explain. The user's claim "it is above the Delta" is a misconception — Delta is at ~1.23 GeV, but eta production requires enough energy to produce eta (547 MeV) + proton, so threshold is ~1.486 GeV. 1.45 is below that, impossible.
